title: TPeezy's Cobblemon Pack
description: An upgraded version of the official Fabric Cobblemon Modpack with many additions, including Trainers, Vic's PB, Extra Structures, and more! This modpack serves as the basis for my custom Cobblemon server!
body:
Welcome to TPeezy's Cobblemon Pack! This modpack is designed for the TPeezy Cobblemon Server, but is also designed to be enjoyed in singleplayer as well. With the goal of expanding on the already incredible official Cobblemon experience, I added many cobblemon expansion mods, additional content like guns and new/upgraded structures, fun and high quality resource packs/shaders, and a discord server with integrations. Whether you are joining the official server, playing solo, or running your own server with friends, you can expect an enjoyable, rewarding, and unique Cobblemon experience with this modpack!

This modpack takes the official Fabric Cobblemon Modpack and adds many additions, including but not limited to:

Mods:
- Vic's Point Blank
- Katter's Structures
- Cobblemon Additions
- Cobblemon Megashowdon
- Cobblemon Unchained
- Cobblemon Trainers
- Cobblemon Extra Structures
- Cobblemon Alpha Project
- Cobblemon Hunt
- Cobblemon Size Variations
- Discord server and integrations
- many QOL mods

Resource Packs:
- Cobblemon UI
- CobbleMotion + extras
- Freshmoves
- BareBones + extras
- Enhanced Boss Bars
- Even Better Enchants
- many QOL and fun extras

Shaders (just the default from the OG modpack):
- Complementary Unbound
- Complimentary Reimagined

These are all aimed at making a fun, chaotic, and unique Cobblemon experience for anyone looking for something beyond the typical Cobblemon play through.

Thanks for checking out my modpack! I'd love to hear any feedback, issues, critiques, reccomendations, or anything else you'd like to share with me!
